{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Korok Mask Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Korok Mask Model.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Korok Mask Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Korok Mask Icon.png }} |caption= |type= Armor |game= BotW, TotK |other= HWL |cost= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 50 [[Rupee]]s }} |value= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 15 Rupees |TotK= 600 [[Rupee]]s }} |location= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= [[Lost Woods]] |TotK= [[Forest Coliseum]] }} |uses= Finding [[Korok]]s |strength= 1 |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Korok Mask|Korok Masks|Series, BotW, TotK, HWL, HWDE}} is a recurring [[Item]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, HWL, HWDE}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Descriptions BotW}} In the {{TMT}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack for {{BotW|-}}, obtaining the Korok Mask is the objective of the "[[EX Strange Mask Rumors]]" [[Side Quest]]. As part of the Quest, [[Link]] must read the ''[[Super Rumor Mill V1]]'' at the [[Woodland Stable]]. According to [[Traysi]], the Korok Mask is inhabited by a spirit. She has also heard that it occasionally shakes and makes noises when worn, which she theorizes may be due to hidden friends nearby. Finally, Traysi shares that it is supposedly hidden in the hollow of a [[Tree]] in a forest that makes people lose their way. The Korok Mask can be found in a [[Hidden Chest]] south of the pair of stationary [[Torch]]es at the [[Lost Woods]]' entrance. It is located in the mouth of an [[Ogre Tree]]. After obtaining the Korok Mask, [[Granté]] will begin selling it for 50 [[Rupee]]s.{{Note|Prior to the [[The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild#Updates|Version 1.3.3 Update]], Granté would not sell any Armor that is exclusive to the ''[[Breath of the Wild Expansion Pass]]''. This meant that the Korok Mask could not be replaced if sold, which was noted in the description of the Mask. The Korok Mask's description was changed in the Version 1.3.3 Update as the Mask could now be replaced.}} When worn, the Mask provides the [[Korok Seed Sensor]] [[Added Effect]], reacting when a [[Korok]] is hiding nearby. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Descriptions TotK}} {{Stub|TotK}} The Korok Mask can be found in the [[Forest Coliseum]] in the [[Great Hyrule Forest Depths]]. When [[Link]] enters the Coliseum, he will be greeted by two [[Yiga Footsoldier]]s, who release a [[Black Hinox]] to attack him. Once Link defeats the Black Hinox, a shroud of [[Gloom]] over a [[Treasure Chest]] clears, allowing him to collect the Korok Mask. ==Other Appearances== ==={{HWL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|HWDE}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * The Korok Mask is identical in appearance to the Mask worn by [[Makar]] from {{TWW}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Korok Mask Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of the Korok Mask File:HWL Korok Mask Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{HWL|-}}}}Korok Mask icon File:HWL Korok Mask Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{HWL|-}}}}Korok Mask Salon icon File:HWDE Korok Mask Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{HWDE|-}}}}Korok Mask icon File:HWDE Korok Mask Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{HWDE|-}}}}Korok Mask Salon icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Armor * Fairy Clothing * Korok Aura * Mask }} {{Notes}} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Korok Mask}}
